title: [Info Docs] Architecture Reference and Workflow Diagrams for PR #277
body:
Architecture reference material and workflow diagrams for the older verified construction checkpoint in [PR #277](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/277), conditional κ = 0.000711045547624400. The inspected later PR266 checkpoint is stronger.

![High-level architecture overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hcg890/integer-mult-bounds/8ddcabe87b874c0cb6d7ece0bd58a6f7d969bd3e/docs/multicut-delayed-inverse-checkpoint/summary-functional.svg)

[Open the architecture reference PDF](https://github.com/hcg890/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8ddcabe87b874c0cb6d7ece0bd58a6f7d969bd3e/docs/multicut-delayed-inverse-checkpoint/functional_architecture.pdf). It contains 51 pages: pages 2–5 have visual architecture/workflow views, and the remaining material supplies contents, explanations, requirements, source references and coverage limits. It is not represented as a 51-page diagram or a complete wiring schematic.

[Build instructions and scope](https://github.com/hcg890/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8ddcabe87b874c0cb6d7ece0bd58a6f7d969bd3e/docs/multicut-delayed-inverse-checkpoint/README.md).

The high-level overview shows operand representation, transforms, exact recovery and product output, with separate supplier support. The local supplier workflow connects ten compiler blocks. These diagrams summarize architecture and compiler flow; they do not expand inherited theorem internals or establish a complete physical connection diagram.

## Scope correction

The rejected logical PDF, combined PDF and logical preview were removed first
in commit `39aa2d250501747fda0e943d4345ae8328316dd9`. A second follow-up removes
all eight unused JOINT259_CONNECTION_* files and narrows the renderer, cache
planner and preview exporter to functional output only. Direct logical and
combined requests are rejected before planning. No page SVGs are published.

The final public allowlist is exactly 18 static build/support files plus 12
generated artifacts. The dependency index retains architecture block relations;
raw operation ABI, state-version fields and extractor promises are removed.
Original independent review records are explicitly historical. The newly
recorded functional-only tests provide the current narrowed-build evidence.
No separate extract or additional supporting document is published.

## Validation

The final functional-only suite passed in 34.21 seconds with 51 pages: cold,
warm and clean byte equality; decoded drawing streams, text and navigation;
full-page raster equality at 40 dpi; 12 retained mutation cases; five dependency
and five damaged-cache controls; source-pin rejection; cache round trips;
51 linked vector SVG pages; and six rejected-family entry-point checks.
The fresh-cache build passed in 2.61 seconds with only the allowed output family.
All eight removed files were physically absent from the tested staging tree.

The regenerated PDF changes only its cover, scope and build pages. All 48 other
page drawings, including visual pages 2–5, are unchanged. The architecture
preview bytes remain identical. Changed pages and the preview were visually
inspected. Eleven artifact hashes are pinned in EXPECTED_ARTIFACTS.json;
the incremental runtime receipt is intentionally environment-specific.

The scientific source archive's all-eight-stage PASS and immutable source
binding are preserved. This cleanup does not replay or extend the scientific
proof, change the construction inputs or assert visual completeness. The result
remains conditional on the inherited compiler, chart, routing, prime, recovery
and analytic interfaces. Contributor credits, licenses and assistance
disclosures remain in the construction's heritage record.
